fields.value: Replication package "Tournament Incentives Affect Perceived Stress and Hormonal Stress Responses"

dsDescriptionValue.value: The replication package of "Tournament Incentives Affect Perceived Stress and Hormonal Stress Responses" contains i) the zTree programs that were used to run the experiment, and ii) the anonymized data and scripts that were used to produce the results of the paper. The data is collected in the summer of 2016. The README.txt file describes in greater detail how to use both datasets to replicate the experiment and results.

datasetVersion.citation: Tom Stolp; Thomas Dohmen; Ingrid Rohde, 2023, "Replication package "Tournament Incentives Affect Perceived Stress and Hormonal Stress Responses"", https://doi.org/10.34894/9KL75I, DataverseNL, V3
